services.subtitle: We're a young team combining engineering and agronomy to develop technology solutions alongside real producers. Every project we take on helps us grow and improve what we offer.

items.title: IoT Sensors
items.text: Field sensors that monitor moisture, temperature and nutrients in real time, in continuous development alongside the producers who use them.
items.details: We're rolling out an IoT sensor network that connects the field with the ORION platform. We measure soil moisture, temperature, electrical conductivity, pH and local weather conditions, and we iterate on each device's design based on direct feedback from the people using them on their plots.

items.title: Operational Traceability
items.text: Digital record of field tasks, applications and inputs, built to grow alongside each partner's operation.
items.details: We offer a digital record of field activities (tasks, applications, inputs) so every producer has clear traceability of their operation. We keep adding features based on the real cases we work on with our first partners.

items.title: Satellite Imagery
items.text: Satellite imagery processing to help identify early water stress and crop variability.
items.details: We process multispectral satellite imagery to generate vegetation indices (like NDVI) and spatial variability maps. It's a capability we keep refining, aiming to make it ever more precise and useful for field decision-making.

aiagent.desc: ORUS's AI agent doesn't just analyze data: it acts. It learns your patterns, anticipates problems and delivers the right information at the right moment so you never lose control of your operation.
